summary.headline: Enmities and the Twelfth House
summary.text: Chapter 36 explains astrological judgments about enmities and the significations of the twelfth house, using the twelfth sign and its lord, the planet in the twelfth, the part of enemies, Saturn, dignities, aspects, and house positions to assess enemies, harm, reputation, and their nobility or strength.
